emma: Quick bring-up notes for 'vectoria-9.5b' int6 smoke. ran internal GTN slice for chat+summarize (mix of short/long). numbers below.

emma: TL;DR: int6 looks promising for baseline traffic but there are 2 edge cases where fallback routing -> int8 or int4 is needed to hit latency/SLO. recommending hybrid default route + prefix cache.

raj: can you drop the key numbers?

emma: throughput per replica: ~85 tok/s steady-state (1 GPU). p50 ~ 28ms/token, p95 ~ 110ms/token, p99 ~ 360ms/token on 8k context slices.

emma: quality: GTN@100 (our composite) = 0.82 vs production baseline 0.85 (delta -0.03). ROUGE-L on summarization down ~1.6 pts. indistinguishable on short chat prompts.

mike: cost calc?

emma: simple econ: GPU cost assumed $2.00/hr (spot avg). tokens/hr per replica = 85 * 3600 = 306k. cost per 1M tokens = (2.00 / 306000) * 1e6 ≈ $6.54. with batching tweaks we can push tok/s to 110 -> cost ≈ $4.77/M.

jen: that cost looks good vs our current 13b int8 at ~$9/M. but quality delta matters for GTN product. product-sam should weigh impact.

sam: pinged. if we route 60% -> vectoria-int6 and 40% -> fallback int8 for longform, what's net cost?

emma: rough mix calc: assume avg request tokens 300. route ratio 60/40, int6 cost $6.54/M, int8 cost $9.00/M (current). blended = 0.6*6.54 + 0.4*9.00 = 7.224/M. Compared to 9.00/M full int8 -> ~20% savings.

raj: what are the "2 edge cases"?

emma: 1) long-context summarization (>=4k) triggers p99 tail spikes and alignment regressions (GTN drop to 0.77). 2) adversarial prompt priming where int6 hallucination increases on rare prompts (we saw ~2x error rate). both mitigations: prefix cache for long contexts (reduces KV pressure) and for adversarial slice route to int8 based on novelty signal.

mike: can we implement a quick policy: route by token-length to int8 for >4k contexts and else int6, plus 5% shadowing to measure quality drift?

jen: +1. also suggest a soft canary: start with 5% traffic to int6 for product, monitor GTN and error rates for 48h, then step to 25/50.

deploy-bot: Deployment plan created: canary-int6-vectoria -> ticket #INFER-4231 (auto-generated).

sam: product note: if GTN hit is >0.02 drop we pause. otherwise ok to proceed. keep me in loop.

emma: I'll push a short eval harness with priming-adversarial set and longform slice. PR coming in an hour. code snippet for route heuristics I'm planning:

emma: ```
// pseudo-route heuristic
if (request.context_tokens > 4000) route = "vectoria-int8";
else if (novelty_score > 0.85) route = "vectoria-int8";
else route = "vectoria-int6";
// 5% sampling -> route_shadow = "vectoria-int8"
```

raj: sounds solid. lets include latency SLO checks and cost telemetry. can ops add quota guard for burst?

mike: ops can add a burst cap and auto-fallback once queue depth crosses threshold.

jen: agree on canary cadence. request a short one-pager with the blended econ numbers + gating criteria.

emma: will DM a one-pager and attach the initial GTN slice results. thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
